ecological_question: Does independently recorded general seagrass appearance contain year-ahead information about exact-point Thalassia recorded retention beyond source abundance, depth, position, season, stable transect identity, year and monitoring agency?

measurement.point_year_aggregation: mean ordinal appearance score across valid focal rows at the same Transect x Site x AssessmentYear
measurement.rationale: The TBISMP field manual defines a trained general seagrass appearance/condition rating; the database uses Very Good where the manual describes the top category as excellent.

transition_population.unit: stable Transect x meter-mark Site x consecutive AssessmentYear transition
transition_population.source_requirement: Thalassia recorded with valid Appearance in source year
transition_population.target_requirement: same Transect x Site sampled in AssessmentYear + 1
transition_population.outcome: target-year Thalassia recorded retention (1) versus recorded loss (0)

primary_analysis.within_node_centering: source appearance score minus mean source appearance score among eligible transitions for that Transect
primary_analysis.model: logit(retained_next_year) ~ appearance_within_node + source_bb + source_depth_m + site_m + sin_doy + cos_doy + node_id FE + source_year FE + monitoring_agency
primary_analysis.estimator: L2-regularized logistic regression with C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=3000
primary_analysis.expected_direction: positive: better-than-usual local appearance predicts higher next-year recorded retention

interpretation.ci_above_zero: General appearance carries positive year-ahead information beyond source abundance and controls, consistent with an integrated visual-condition early-warning dimension.
interpretation.ci_overlaps_zero: No robust independent year-ahead information from general appearance after abundance, site and survey controls.
interpretation.ci_below_zero: The expected health ordering is contradicted after adjustment; reject the simple visual-condition early-warning interpretation.

sensitivity.rule: Repeat the identical model with target 2016 restored; report whether interval classification changes.

claim_boundary: This is post-hoc historical temporal ecology, not a response-unopened prospective confirmation.
Recorded retention/loss is an observation-state endpoint, not demographic survival/extinction.
Appearance is subjective despite annual training and is not a physiological measurement.
A positive coefficient does not identify heat, disease, nutrient, light or clonal mechanism.
Do not retune category scores, target years, node subsets, lag windows or controls after the result is opened.
